definitions: Graphical representations on a chart or graph that indicate the variability or uncertainty around a data point, extending vertically.
Lines on a graph that show the range of possible values for a data point, typically representing standard deviation or confidence intervals.
examples: The scientist added vertical error bars to the graph to show the standard deviation.
The report included a chart with vertical error bars illustrating the margin of error.
Always include vertical error bars when presenting experimental data.
